integrity_statement: One theorem with a universal algebraic proof and replayable supplementary finite checks; no independent audit or external verification has been claimed.
scientific_limitations: The congruence class n≡2 (mod 4) is excluded because the derivative locus has positive-dimensional two-value strata.
Only the projective Jacobian singular scheme and quadratic tangent cones are classified, not full hypersurface analytic normal forms or resolutions.
Finite verification samples do not prove the universal statement; the proof is independent of enumeration.
An older equivalent classification under different language is a residual bibliographic risk.
title: The complete singular scheme of the elementary symmetric cubic in characteristic two
